page.layout: One printed page, mostly blank, with manuscript annotations in the upper and middle areas (not transcribed). Bottom left corner: a torn fragment of a printed calendar, dates 21 to 31 in a column, with partly hidden entries.
page.notes: Manuscript annotations, excluded as handwriting: "Gal. V. 948." (struck through, top left) and "Rud. 828. Kat. 7.79" (middle left). Calendar fragment: the lower-left corner is torn and stained, so most entries are cut off after the first letters; the red saint names are only partly legible. The entries are given as far as they can be read. The calendar letters and dates are transcribed as printed.
